TOP_N_NOTE: TOP_N RULING 2026-07-31: cut from 12 to 8 per slot. The desks were publishing ~184 articles a week between them while all article pages combined drew ~16 weekly views, so slots 9 to 12 were reaching nobody. Cutting the tail reduces per-run spend (fewer researcher, writer, and verifier calls), raises the average significance of what reaches the front page, and lowers exposure to search-engine scaled-content policies, which target high-volume automated publishing. Revisit when distribution catches up to the inventory; this is a quality-over-volume decision, not a cost-only one.

sources.note: source_tier drives editorial weight. primary = the official public record (courts, central bank, Congress: documents, rulings, and press releases straight from the institution). major = established outlets with editorial standards, DELIBERATELY spread across the political spectrum so the desk never sees one side's telling alone; each domain carries a published bias/factual rating in site/data/credibility.json, shown to readers with attribution. mixed = aggregated or rumor-adjacent feeds (never publish alone). All feeds below are free and keyless, verified live 2026-07-19. AP and Reuters retired their public RSS (license-only now): documented as the paid upgrade path. The honesty layer is the pipeline (tiering, cross-outlet corroboration, adversarial verifier, primary-source linking, transparent outlet ratings), not any single API.

dedupe.note: Near-identical stories across outlets (same event, many rewrites) collapse into one cluster by normalized-headline token overlap or shared URL. The cluster keeps the highest-tier source as primary and lists the rest as corroboration; for the news desk, corroboration ACROSS the bias spectrum is what earns top billing. CROSS-OUTLET SIGNAL (2026-07-31): full-token Jaccard almost never fires across outlets that word the same event differently, so only 4% of clusters carried any corroboration and stories published citing one source. A second, conservative signal merges when headlines share at least min_shared_entities distinctive entities (capitalized words and numbers, which survive rewording), the items are within cross_outlet_window_hours of each other, AND token overlap clears cross_outlet_jaccard_floor. False merges are worse than single-sourcing, so these thresholds are tuned to zero observed false merges, not to a corroboration target.
